versions.changelog:
- Migrated all skill definitions and documentation from Chinese filenames to standardized English directory and file names.
- Added 17 new English-named skill folders with updated SKILL.md files and reference materials.
- Removed 18 previously existing skill folders/files with Chinese names to avoid duplication and unify structure.
- No major content changes; primary update is organizational, enhancing cross-language accessibility and maintainability.

儿科学核心技能知识库 (Pediatrics-PMPH-10edition) 1.0.0

- 首次发布，基于人卫版《儿科学》第10版构建，涵盖184项系统化儿科临床技能。
- 每项技能独立目录，标准化定义，支持场景化查询与执行流程。
- 涵盖新生儿、发育、营养、免疫接种、各系统常见病、急重症、遗传代谢、实验检查等类别。
- 提供详细技能分类索引及模块化仓库结构，便于查找与扩展。
